_: The security headers tradecn.dev sends on every response. infra/lib/tradecn-site-stack.ts puts them in the CloudFront response headers policy (the infra workflow redeploys when this file changes) and scripts/site/smoke.ts serves them locally, so a page the policy would break fails the smoke before it is published. Scripts are 'self' only: the pages' script is /site.js, and the previews are the /preview/assets/ bundle. Styles allow inline because the pages carry their palette in a <style> block and the components set style attributes. frame-src and frame-ancestors are 'self' for the preview iframes. connect-src is 'self' for the search index, /search.json, which site.js fetches when the search opens. font-src is 'self' for the two default faces the preview bundle self-hosts under /preview/assets/ (Inter and JetBrains Mono through Fontsource, plus the Atkinson pair the typography demo loads); the embed build never inlines a font as a data: URL, so no data: source is needed.
content-security-policy: default-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; connect-src 'self'; font-src 'self'; form-action 'none'; frame-ancestors 'self'; frame-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'
